name: Renord

hero.subtitle: Support for circulation, swelling reduction and tissue recovery after procedures and injuries
hero.intro: Renord combines bromelain, rutin and L-arginine to support key processes involved in tissue recovery through three complementary mechanisms.
hero.doseNote: One yellow and one blue capsule, between meals.

audience.heading: A clearly defined role, without unnecessary complexity
audience.body: Designed for adults recovering from minor medical procedures, surgery or injuries, particularly when swelling, bruising and the need for additional tissue support are present.

items.title: Swelling and inflammation
items.body: Bromelain is a proteolytic enzyme used to support the body during swelling and inflammatory processes.

items.title: Vascular and antioxidant support
items.body: Rutin provides antioxidant and vascular support relevant to microcirculation and capillary function.

items.title: Circulation and tissue renewal
items.body: L-arginine is a nitric oxide precursor and an amino acid involved in protein synthesis, supporting circulation and tissue renewal.

formula.heading: Different roles, one clear purpose
formula.intro: Tissue recovery does not depend on a single pathway. After an injury or procedure, swelling control, microcirculation, oxidative stress and tissue renewal all matter. Renord therefore combines enzymatic, vascular-antioxidant and nutritional support.
formula.calloutBody: The formula brings together three complementary approaches: bromelain for swelling and inflammatory processes, rutin for antioxidant and vascular support, and L-arginine for circulation and nutritional support of tissue renewal.

ingredients.heading: Composition and the role of each ingredient

items.name: Bromelain
items.role: A proteolytic enzyme from pineapple. It has been studied in post-procedural swelling, pain and recovery and is the formula’s main ingredient directed at edema and inflammatory processes.

items.name: Rutin
items.role: A bioflavonoid with antioxidant properties and a role in supporting capillaries, the vascular barrier and microcirculation.

items.name: L-arginin
items.role: An amino acid and nitric oxide precursor. Supports NO production, circulation and protein synthesis involved in tissue renewal.

useCases.heading: Practical situations for use
items: During recovery after minor procedures and surgery
For swelling and bruising after injury or intervention
During recovery of superficial wounds that are healing normally
As complementary support alongside other recovery measures when considered appropriate by a clinician

notes.heading: Safe and responsible use
notes.warnings: Extra caution is needed in people using anticoagulant or antiplatelet medicines, vasodilators, or in those with diabetes or recurrent herpes. Pregnant or breastfeeding women and people taking tetracycline or amoxicillin should consult a clinician before use. Renord does not replace wound care, bleeding control, antibiotics, analgesics or surgery when these are required.
